basePrice.description: The island's reference price for bread: everyone's initial price limit

bestLandBid.description: Highest bid for land that found no seller yesterday

bidRaise.description: How much a person raises its price limit after a day without a full ration, scaled by the share of the ration missed

bidRelax.description: How much a person lowers its price limit after a day with a full ration, to test whether bread can be had for less

birthChance.description: Daily chance that a person with zero hunger has a child

additionalProperties.description: Today's posted offers: price per bread, by producer id

breadAskPrice.description: Today's posted offers: price per bread, by producer id

additionalProperties.description: Today's posted offers: bread for sale, by producer id

breadAskQty.description: Today's posted offers: bread for sale, by producer id

additionalProperties.description: Today's buy orders, one per bread, keyed <agent id>.<unit>: the most the buyer pays for it

breadBids.description: Today's buy orders, one per bread, keyed <agent id>.<unit>: the most the buyer pays for it

breadWasted.description: Bread produced today and not sold (it expires)

breadsPerLand.description: Bread each plot yields per tick

daysPerYear.description: Ticks in a year; ticks are days

droughtChance.description: Daily chance that a drought starts (when the weather is normal)

droughtDaysLeft.description: Days left of the current drought

droughtImpact.description: Share of the harvest lost during a drought

epidemicChance.description: Daily chance that an epidemic starts

epidemicDaysLeft.description: Days left of the current epidemic

epidemicRation.description: Breads needed to reset hunger during an epidemic

freeLandPrice.description: What the island asks today for a free plot. Falls by landPriceDrop each day free plots find no buyer, so abandoned land gets cheaper until someone can afford it

goldenChance.description: Daily chance that a golden age starts (when the weather is normal)

goldenDaysLeft.description: Days left of the current golden age

goldenImpact.description: Extra share of harvest during a golden age

hungerPerDay.description: Hunger added on a day without any bread. Missing one bread of the ration adds 0, missing two adds 1

islandLandPrice.description: Price the island asks for a plot when it starts selling free plots, and again after all plots are taken

additionalProperties.description: Offers to sell one plot, by agent id

landAsks.description: Offers to sell one plot, by agent id

additionalProperties.description: Offers to buy one plot from another producer, by agent id

landBids.description: Offers to buy one plot from another producer, by agent id

landHorizon.description: Days of expected profit a plot is worth to an average trader

landPrice.description: Price of the last plot traded between producers

landPriceDrop.description: Daily drop of freeLandPrice while free plots find no buyer

landsFree.description: Plots the island still has for sale. Buying one when none is left is rejected

marketPrice.description: Average price paid for bread in the last day with trades

maxBreadsPerDay.description: Normal daily ration: eating this many breads resets hunger to 0

maxHunger.description: Hunger above this kills by malnutrition

minPrice.description: Producers never ask less than this

mortalityBase.description: Gompertz a: yearly chance of dying of old age at age 0

mortalityGrowth.description: Gompertz b: growth of the yearly risk per year of age (risk doubles every ln 2 / b, about 7.7 years)

notFullyFed.description: People who did not eat a full ration today

priceCut.description: A producer with unsold bread cuts its price by priceCut x the unsold share of what it offered

priceRise.description: How much a producer raises its price after selling its whole stock

productionCost.description: Share of each sale that covers production cost; the rest is the producer's profit

productionFactor.description: Today's harvest multiplier: lower in a drought, higher in a golden age

ration.description: Today's ration: maxBreadsPerDay, or epidemicRation during an epidemic. Nobody eats more than this

scarcity.description: Share of today's buy orders that went unfilled

sellRate.description: Share of today's bread that was sold

starvationDays.description: Consecutive days without any bread that kill a person

undercut.description: A producer left with bread prices at most this far below the market average, since a price far above it is plainly out of line

unmetDemand.description: Buy orders placed today that found no bread within their limit
